mode: static-only peer review; no source changes or H/Python/Rust execution

evaluation_provider remains the existing child module of owner_support and can access its private ancestor method.
support::Admission retains its existing pub(super) visibility in the q24 fixture module hierarchy.

The same owned admission/runtime/config already crossed the original start await; no new Send/Sync/future bound or boxed future is introduced. This is a static type-surface observation, not a compiler result.
assertions_retained: all native provider test bodies and their assertions are byte-identical
